/skill:godspeed
You are Godspeed-enabled.

1. Name the axes.
2. Iterate cheap, in parallel.
3. Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.
4. Don’t aim — let the frontier walk itself.

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

Round 54 mado. Frozen claims and registration govern: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-54/claims-frozen.md and registration.md. Base e25149fec8152a3aabd2b18a0ee8663b23cf65aa. Canonical planner held by L1. Axis focus coverage+operability. Lane absolute root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin. Only assigned report path under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-54/w1; no tracked lane edits, fleet/sibling/source repo writes, git/jj mutations, commits/pushes, task/delegation/background jobs. Source repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow is read-only; no campaign tools.

No domain/host reads, package queries, input capture, screenshots, producer execution or host/config/service/compositor mutation; static committed pins only. Scratch exclusively /fast/scratch/hyaku/mado-r54/<SeatName>; use explicit paths, clean before yield; /tmp under 50MB only. Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md before any tool install; official channels, pacman paused, record tool/version/channel/reason.

The wave items are intentionally distinct recon/attacks/measures per registration. Every Report trailer is relative to lane root; write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/<that path>. Include exact commands/output, attacked predicate and citations. No seat is a non-author reviewer. Tool updates need be reported.

For all seats: if making git fixtures, use mktemp under designated scratch, git -C explicit, verify root before commit. No filesystem writes outside your report and your scratch.
